text.autoconfig.origins-randomiser.title: Origins Randomizer Config
text.autoconfig.origins-randomiser.optio: Toggle global messages announcing a player's new origin
Toggle randomization of all layers (false = only randomize origins:origin)
Toggle whether players can use the /randomise command
Toggle whether the use of /randomise is limited to a set number of times
Set the number of times /randomise can be used (only works if limitCommandUses = true)
Toggle if players have a set number of lives before they are put in spectator mode
Set the number of lives players start with
Set the number of lives between each origin randomization
Set the number of sleeps between each origin randomization
Toggle assigning a random origin on a player's first join
Toggle whether new origin can be the same as the previous one
Toggle showing the origin selection screen after death (only works if randomizeOrigins = false)
Set a player's origins:origin to origins:human instead of a random one whenever randomization occurs (leaves other layers untouched)
origins-randomiser.message.command.disab: Use of the /randomise command has been disabled.
origins-randomiser.message.command.isHum: As a human, you are not able to use the /randomise command.
origins-randomiser.message.command.limit: Use of the /randomise command has been limited. You start with %d uses.
origins-randomiser.message.command.out: You have no more uses of /randomise left.
origins-randomiser.message.command.unlim: Use of the /randomise command is unlimited. Toggle this with 'limitCommandUses'.
origins-randomiser.message.command.usesL: You now have %d uses of the /randomise command remaining.
origins-randomiser.message.lives.between: You will receive a random origin after every %d lives.
origins-randomiser.message.lives.disable: Lives are disabled. Toggle them with 'enableLives'.
origins-randomiser.message.lives.enabled: Lives have been enabled. You start with %d lives.
origins-randomiser.message.lives.untilRa: You now have %d more lives until your origin is randomized.
origins-randomiser.message.sleeps.betwee: You will receive a random origin after every %d sleeps.
origins-randomiser.message.sleeps.untilR: You now have %d more sleeps until your origin is randomized.
origins-randomiser.reason.command: %s randomized their origin and is now a %s
origins-randomiser.reason.firstJoin: %s spawned for the first time as a %s
origins-randomiser.reason.sleep: %s slept and woke up as a %s
